actions.name: Trample
actions.description: As a full action, the mech uses the trample universal creature ability. This deals low bludgeoning damage as a mech weapon with a level equal to the mech's tier. The Reflex save DC equals 12 + 1/2 x the mech's tier.

description.value:
A pair of massive, reinforced legs provides enhanced durability and can mount a weapon.

Special: Trample (2 PP) - As a full action, the mech moves up to its speed, passing through squares occupied by creatures smaller than itself, dealing low bludgeoning damage to each creature whose space it passes through.
